指标定义 / MetricDefinition · metric-definition.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:metric-definition",
  "title": "metric-definition",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:metric-definition"
    },
    "metric_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "input_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "contract_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "version": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "uniqueItems": true
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "contract_id",
          "version",
          "fields"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "required_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "required_complete_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "window": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "start_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        },
        "end_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "TAI-relative nanoseconds as decimal string; semantic validator enforces int64 range"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "start_ns",
        "end_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "reducer": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "count",
            "sum",
            "mean",
            "min",
            "max",
            "fraction",
            "interval-utilization",
            "quantile"
          ]
        },
        "field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "predicate": {
          "$ref": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:predicate"
        },
        "interval_start_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "interval_end_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "available_intervals_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "resource_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "amount_field": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
        },
        "aggregation": {
          "const": "resource-capacity-time"
        },
        "clip_to_window": {
          "const": true
        },
        "outside_availability_policy": {
          "const": "reject"
        },
        "overcapacity_policy": {
          "const": "reject"
        },
        "quantile": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1
        },
        "quantile_method": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "linear",
            "nearest",
            "lower",
            "higher",
            "midpoint"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "op"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "unit": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "direction": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "maximize",
        "minimize",
        "target"
      ]
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "value",
        "unit"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "target_deviation": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "kind": {
          "const": "absolute"
        },
        "scale": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "value": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0
            },
            "unit": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "value",
            "unit"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "kind",
        "scale"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "missing_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "undefined",
        "fail-evaluation"
      ]
    },
    "valid_range": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "lower": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "upper": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "lower",
        "upper"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "implementation_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "test_fixtures": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "deduplicate_by": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "metric_id",
    "version",
    "label",
    "input_contracts",
    "required_fields",
    "required_complete_contracts",
    "window",
    "reducer",
    "unit",
    "direction",
    "missing_policy",
    "valid_range",
    "implementation_ref",
    "test_fixtures",
    "deduplicate_by"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "direction": {
            "const": "target"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "target",
          "target_deviation"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "fraction"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "predicate"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "interval-utilization"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "interval_start_field",
              "interval_end_field",
              "available_intervals_ref",
              "resource_field",
              "amount_field",
              "aggregation",
              "clip_to_window",
              "outside_availability_policy",
              "overcapacity_policy"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "enum": [
                  "sum",
                  "mean",
                  "min",
                  "max",
                  "quantile"
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "field"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "properties": {
              "op": {
                "const": "quantile"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "reducer": {
            "required": [
              "quantile",
              "quantile_method"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",

      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v1:model-integration-spec"
    },

      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"

      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "manifest_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "input_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "contract_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "version": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "uniqueItems": true
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "contract_id",
          "version",
          "fields"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "output_contracts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "contract_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "version": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "uniqueItems": true
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "contract_id",
          "version",
          "fields"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "private_state_schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "time_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "continuous",
        "event",
        "recorded-replay"
      ]
    },
    "reads": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "read_bindings": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "component": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
          },
          "asset_selector": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "previous-commit",
              "current-stage",
              "owned-start",
              "continuous-service"
            ]
          },
          "contract_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "producer_instance_id": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "component",
          "asset_selector",
          "source",
          "contract_ref",
          "producer_instance_id"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "allOf": [
          {
            "if": {
              "properties": {
                "source": {
                  "const": "current-stage"
                }
              }
            },
            "then": {
              "properties": {

      ]
    },

            "additionalProperties": false,
            "allOf": [

                "if": {

                "then": {
                  "required": [
                    "lower",
                    "upper"
                  ]
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [

          "weight",

    "constraints": {

      "items": {

        "properties": {

              "gte",
              "gt"

            "type": "object",

              },

                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              }
            },
            "required": [

              "unit"
            ],

          },

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [

              "report-only"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [

          "op",
          "bound",
          "severity"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0
    },
    "aggregation": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "weighted-utility",
        "pareto-only"
      ]
    },
    "missing_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "unscorable",
        "partial-renormalize"
      ]
    },
    "failed_run_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "retain-unscorable",
        "declared-penalty"
      ]
    },
    "failure_penalty_utility": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1
    },
    "censoring_policy": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "retain-separate",
        "complete-windows-only"
      ]
    },
    "comparison_keys": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,191}$"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "uncertainty": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "method": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "none",
            "paired-bootstrap",
            "independent-bootstrap"
          ]
        },
        "confidence_level": {
          "type": "number",
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
          "exclusiveMaximum": 1
        },
        "resamples": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "evaluation_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$",
          "description": "Unsigned seed decimal; semantic validator enforces 0 <= value <= 18446744073709551615. Not a time quantity."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "method",
        "confidence_level",
        "resamples",
        "evaluation_seed"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "pareto_tolerance": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "pareto_rule": {
      "const": "quantized-utility-origin-zero-exact"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "profile_id",
    "version",
    "inherits",
    "objectives",
    "constraints",
    "aggregation",
    "missing_policy",
    "failed_run_policy",
    "censoring_policy",
    "comparison_keys",
    "uncertainty",
    "pareto_tolerance",
    "pareto_rule"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "failed_run_policy": {
            "const": "declared-penalty"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "required": [
          "failure_penalty_utility"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "node_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"

            ]
          },

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [

          "input_domain",
          "output_domain",
          "party_id",
          "approved_release_ref"

        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,

    },
    "edges": {

        "type": "object",

    "runtime_prediction_ref": {
      "anyOf": [

    "simulated_sharing_ref": {

  },
  "required": [

    "profiles",
    "evidence_basis",
    "nodes",
    "edges",
    "max_microsteps",

  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    },

    },
    "gaps": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "start_ns": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",

          },

            "type": "string",

  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:rule-parameter-catalog",
  "title": "rule-parameter-catalog",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:rule-parameter-catalog"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "authority_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "parameters": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "parameter_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "target_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "outcome-rule",
              "score-profile"
            ]
          },
          "target_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "binding": {
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "kind": {
                    "const": "rule-parameter"
                  },
                  "parameter_name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "kind",
                  "parameter_name"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false
              },
              {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "kind": {
                    "const": "score-objective-weight"
                  },
                  "metric_ref": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "kind",
                  "metric_ref"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false
              }
            ]
          },
          "value_type": {
            "const": "number"
          },
          "unit": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 256
          },
          "minimum": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "maximum": {
            "type": "number"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "parameter_id",
          "target_kind",
          "target_ref",
          "binding",
          "value_type",
          "unit",
          "minimum",
          "maximum"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 64
    },
    "client_mutable": {
      "const": false
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "authority_ref",
    "parameters",
    "client_mutable"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
1.2 · 被动安全事件假设 / safety-event-hypothesis · revision12/schemas/safety-event-hypothesis.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:safety-event-hypothesis",
  "title": "safety-event-hypothesis",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:safety-event-hypothesis"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "event_kind": {
      "const": "civil.geometric-contact-screening"
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "disabled",
        "event-only",
        "declared-state-effect"
      ]
    },
    "detector_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "geometry_profile_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "method": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "not-evaluated",
        "sampled",
        "continuous"
      ]
    },
    "evaluation_window": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "start_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        },
        "end_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "start_ns",
        "end_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "resolution_ns": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
      "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
    },
    "tolerance": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 256
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "value",
        "unit"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "effect_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "required_coverage": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "release_profile_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "event_kind",
    "mode",
    "detector_ref",
    "geometry_profile_ref",
    "method",
    "evaluation_window",
    "resolution_ns",
    "tolerance",
    "effect_ref",
    "required_coverage",
    "release_profile_ref"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "mode": {
            "const": "disabled"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "detector_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          },
          "geometry_profile_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          },
          "effect_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          },
          "method": {
            "const": "not-evaluated"
          },
          "resolution_ns": {
            "const": "0"
          }
        }
      },
      "else": {
        "properties": {
          "detector_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "geometry_profile_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          },
          "method": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "sampled",
              "continuous"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "mode": {
            "const": "event-only"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "effect_ref": {
            "type": "null"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "mode": {
            "const": "declared-state-effect"
          }
        }
      },
      "then": {
        "properties": {
          "effect_ref": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
1.2 · 情景事件计划 / scenario-event-plan · revision12/schemas/scenario-event-plan.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-event-plan",
  "title": "scenario-event-plan",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scenario-event-plan"
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "capability_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "target_model_path": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)*$"
    },
    "target_asset_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "payload_schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 256
    },
    "payload": {
      "type": "object"
    },
    "trigger": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "scheduled"
            },
            "at_tick_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "at_tick_ns"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "condition"
            },
            "predicate_ref": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
            },
            "basis": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "truth-restricted",
                "party-knowledge"
              ]
            },
            "evaluation_cadence_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            },
            "min_separation_ns": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
              "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
            },
            "max_occurrences": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "acting_party_id": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            },
            "knowledge_policy_ref": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "predicate_ref",
            "basis",
            "evaluation_cadence_ns",
            "min_separation_ns",
            "max_occurrences",
            "acting_party_id",
            "knowledge_policy_ref"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "allOf": [
            {
              "if": {
                "properties": {
                  "basis": {
                    "const": "party-knowledge"
                  }
                }
              },
              "then": {
                "properties": {
                  "acting_party_id": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                  },
                  "knowledge_policy_ref": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                  }
                }
              },
              "else": {
                "properties": {
                  "acting_party_id": {
                    "type": "null"
                  },
                  "knowledge_policy_ref": {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "stochastic"
            },
            "distribution_ref": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
            },
            "window": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "start_ns": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
                  "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
                },
                "end_ns": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
                  "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "start_ns",
                "end_ns"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            },
            "event_count": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "randomness_namespace": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
            },
            "action_independent": {
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "distribution_ref",
            "window",
            "event_count",
            "randomness_namespace",
            "action_independent"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      ]
    },
    "recovery_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "notification_policy_ref": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
    },
    "budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "max_occurrences": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "max_pending": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "max_fanout": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1
        },
        "expiry_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_occurrences",
        "max_pending",
        "max_fanout",
        "expiry_ns"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "visibility": {
      "const": "scenario-authority-only-until-authorized-delivery"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "object_id",
    "version",
    "capability_ref",
    "target_model_path",
    "target_asset_id",
    "payload_schema",
    "payload",
    "trigger",
    "recovery_ref",
    "notification_policy_ref",
    "budget",
    "visibility"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

1.2 · 范围内结果清单 / scoped-result-manifest · revision12/schemas/scoped-result-manifest.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scoped-result-manifest",
  "title": "scoped-result-manifest",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:scoped-result-manifest"
    },
    "manifest_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "population_scope": {
      "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
      "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:population-scope",
      "title": "population-scope",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "schema_id": {
          "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:population-scope"
        },
        "scope_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "purpose": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 256
        },
        "policy_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "entitlement_revision": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "authorized_run_handles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 1000,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "planned_within_scope": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "manifest_handle": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        "completeness_semantics": {
          "const": "within-authorized-scope"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "schema_id",
        "scope_id",
        "purpose",
        "policy_ref",
        "entitlement_revision",
        "authorized_run_handles",
        "planned_within_scope",
        "manifest_handle",
        "completeness_semantics"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "slots": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "logical_run_handle": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "planned",
              "running",
              "completed",
              "failed",
              "cancelled"
            ]
          },
          "attempt_handles": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",

            },

          },

            "anyOf": [

              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "metrics": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "metric_id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                },
                "value": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "number"

                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                },
                "unit": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "minLength": 1,

                },
                "quality": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "valid",
                    "undefined",
                    "not-applicable",
                    "incomplete"
                  ]
                },
                "reason": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 256
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "null"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "metric_id",
                "value",
                "unit",
                "quality",
                "reason"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "allOf": [
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "const": "valid"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "value": {
                        "type": "number"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "enum": [
                          "undefined",
                          "not-applicable"
                        ]
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "value": {
                        "type": "null"
                      },
                      "reason": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "minLength": 1,
                        "maxLength": 256
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "if": {
                    "properties": {
                      "quality": {
                        "const": "incomplete"
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  "then": {
                    "properties": {
                      "reason": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "minLength": 1,
                        "maxLength": 256
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            },
            "minItems": 0,
            "maxItems": 128
          }
        },
        "required": [

    "outcome_rule_ref": {

                "type": "string",

                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
              }

            "required": [

              "object_id",
              "project_id"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          },
          "revision_kind": {

  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:apply-request",
  "title": "apply-request",
  "description": "UI, Agent and CLI share one application-service commit protocol. Authenticated actor identity is supplied only by the trusted transport/session, never by a client principal field. Requested context is intent, never authority. Idempotency ledger key is tenant/project/principal/action/key; a reused key with a different semantic request is rejected.",
  "type": "object",

    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:apply-request"

    },

      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "project_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ui",
        "agent",
        "cli"
      ]
    },
    "context_manifest_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },

      ]
    },

      "format": "date-time",
      "pattern": "Z$"
    },
    "expires_at_utc": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time",
      "pattern": "Z$"
    },

    }
  },
  "required": [

    "project_id",

    "action",

    "semantic_diff_hash",
    "dependency_closure",

    "dependency_scope",
    "full_dependency_closure_handle",
    "budget",
    "policy_versions",

    "status",
    "blocking_codes",
    "warnings",
    "approval_requirement",
    "issued_at_utc",
    "expires_at_utc",
    "report_hash"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "allOf": [

      "if": {
        "properties": {
          "status": {

          }

          }

  ]

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:workspace-state",
  "title": "workspace-state",
  "description": "Authorized bounded lifecycle graph, not the global database. AgentTask is application work, never a civil MissionTask. Existing v1/v12 locks and run_id retain their meaning. Referential integrity, object ownership, lifecycle and immutable history require semantic validation.",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v13:workspace-state"
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "project_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "tenant_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 512
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "active",
            "archived"
          ]
        },
        "revision": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "project_id",
        "tenant_id",
        "name",
        "status",
        "revision"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "work_sessions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "session_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "project_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
          },
          "status": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "open",
              "closed"
            ]
          },
          "transcript_artifact_id": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          },
          "transcript_role": {
            "const": "provenance-only"
          },
          "active_agent_task_id": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "session_id",
          "project_id",
          "status",
          "transcript_artifact_id",
          "transcript_role",
          "active_agent_task_id"
        ],
        "additionalProperties": false
      },
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 64
    },
    "agent_tasks": {

          "type": "string",

            "dynamics",
            "adjudication"
          ]
        },

          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$"
        },

          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "number",

            },

              "type": "string",

              "maxLength": 256
            },
            {
              "type": "boolean"
            }
          ]
        }
      },

        "parameter_id",

      "type": "object",

        },
        "adjudication_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },

        },

        }

          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$"
        },
        "value": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": -1e+100,
              "maximum": 1e+100
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "quality": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "valid",
            "undefined",
            "not_applicable",
            "incomplete"
          ]
        },
        "denominator": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0,
              "maximum": 1e+100
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "reason_code": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 64
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "metric_id",
        "value",
        "unit",
        "quality",
        "denominator",
        "reason_code"
      ],
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "quality": {
                "const": "valid"
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "value": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -1e+100,
                "maximum": 1e+100
              },
              "denominator": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "number",
                    "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1e+100
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "quality": {
                "enum": [
                  "undefined",
                  "not_applicable"
                ]
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "value": {
                "type": "null"
              },
              "reason_code": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 64
              }
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "quality": {
                "const": "incomplete"
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "properties": {
              "reason_code": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 64
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "ObjectRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 5,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "object_id",
        "version",
        "content_hash"
      ]
    },
    "Provenance": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "experiment_lock_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "physical_experiment_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "evaluation_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "seed_plan": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunSeedPlan"
        },
        "run_manifest_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 12,
          "maxLength": 512,
          "pattern": "^sim://projects/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(?:catalog/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|profiles/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)|drafts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/[1-9][0-9]*|locks/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|jobs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|runs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest|results/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|artifacts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest)$"
        },
        "run_manifest_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "source_commit_seq": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 9007199254740991
        },
        "raw_event_manifest_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "score_profile_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ObjectRef"
        },
        "scorer_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "scorer_digest": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "scored_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 20,
          "maxLength": 35,
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "Z$"
        },
        "logging_schema_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "environment_digest": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "experiment_lock_hash",
        "physical_experiment_hash",
        "evaluation_hash",
        "seed_plan",
        "run_manifest_uri",
        "run_manifest_hash",
        "source_commit_seq",
        "raw_event_manifest_hash",
        "score_profile_ref",
        "scorer_version",
        "scorer_digest",
        "scored_at_utc",
        "logging_schema_version",
        "environment_digest"
      ]
    },
    "ResultRow": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "run_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "attempt": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 100
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "succeeded",
            "failed",
            "cancelled",
            "incomplete"
          ]
        },
        "complete": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "metrics": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Metric"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 256
        },
        "provenance": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Provenance"
        },
        "artifacts": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ArtifactRef"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 64
        },
        "diagnostics": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Diagnostic"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 100
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "run_id",
        "attempt",
        "state",
        "complete",
        "metrics",
        "provenance",
        "artifacts",
        "diagnostics"
      ]
    },
    "RunCounts": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "planned": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "queued": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "running": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "succeeded": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "failed": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "cancelled": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "skipped": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 10000
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "planned",
        "queued",
        "running",
        "succeeded",
        "failed",
        "cancelled",
        "skipped"
      ]
    },
    "RunSeedPlan": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "master_seed": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 20,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})$"
        },
        "seed_block_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "replicate_index": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1023
        },
        "rng_derivation_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "master_seed",
        "seed_block_id",
        "replicate_index",
        "rng_derivation_version"
      ]
    },
    "SourceRunManifestRef": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "resource_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 12,
          "maxLength": 512,
          "pattern": "^sim://projects/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(?:catalog/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|profiles/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)|drafts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/[1-9][0-9]*|locks/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|jobs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|runs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest|results/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|artifacts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest)$"
        },
        "content_hash": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 71,
          "maxLength": 71,
          "pattern": "^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"
        },
        "schema_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 5,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        "planned_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "resource_uri",
        "content_hash",
        "schema_version",
        "planned_runs"
      ]
    }
  }
}

MCP · 离线重算版本化指标 · 输出 · sim_rescore_results-output.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
    },
    "data": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Receipt"
    },
    "error": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Error"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ok",
    "request_id"
  ],
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": true
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "data"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "error"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "properties": {
        "ok": {
          "const": false
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "error"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "data"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "Budget": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "max_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "max_parallel_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 64
        },
        "max_cpu_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000000
        },
        "max_wall_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 604800
        },
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 128,
          "maximum": 1048576
        },
        "max_output_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1024,
          "maximum": 1099511627776
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "max_runs",
        "max_parallel_runs",
        "max_cpu_seconds",
        "max_wall_seconds",
        "max_memory_mib_per_worker",
        "max_output_bytes"
      ]
    },
    "Diagnostic": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64,
          "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$"
        },
        "severity": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "info",
            "warning",
            "error"
          ]
        },
        "pointer": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 0,
          "maxLength": 512
        },
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 1000
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "severity",
        "pointer",
        "message"
      ]
    },
    "Error": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "INVALID_ARGUMENT",
            "NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN",
            "REVISION_CONFLICT",
            "REFERENCE_CHANGED",
            "VALIDATION_REQUIRED",
            "BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
            "APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
            "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT",
            "RESULTS_NOT_READY",
            "PARTIAL_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED",
            "RESCORE_FIELDS_MISSING",
            "INCOMPATIBLE_SCORE_PROFILE",
            "EXPIRED_HANDLE",
            "RATE_LIMITED",
            "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "INTERNAL_ERROR"
          ]
        },
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 1000
        },
        "retryable": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "retry_after_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 3600000
        },
        "diagnostics": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Diagnostic"
          },
          "minItems": 0,
          "maxItems": 100
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "message",
        "retryable",
        "diagnostics"
      ]
    },
    "Receipt": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "job_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 3,
          "maxLength": 128,
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}$"
        },
        "job_kind": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "run_batch",
            "rescore"
          ]
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "queued",
            "running"
          ]
        },
        "resource_uri": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 12,
          "maxLength": 512,
          "pattern": "^sim://projects/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(?:catalog/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|profiles/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)|drafts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/[1-9][0-9]*|locks/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|jobs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|runs/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest|results/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}|artifacts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,127}/manifest)$"
        },
        "accepted_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 20,
          "maxLength": 35,
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "Z$"
        },
        "retained_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 20,
          "maxLength": 35,
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "Z$"
        },
        "accepted_budget": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Budget"
        },
        "planned_runs": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 10000
        },
        "poll_after_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1000,
          "maximum": 60000
        },
        "deduplicated": {
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "job_id",
        "job_kind",
        "state",
        "resource_uri",
        "accepted_at_utc",
        "retained_until_utc",
        "accepted_budget",
        "planned_runs",
        "poll_after_ms",
        "deduplicated"
      ]
    }
  }
}
MCP 1.2 · 创建v12场景扩展草案 · 输入 · sim_v12_create_draft-input.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:sim-v12-create-draft-input",
  "title": "sim-v12-create-draft-input",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "project_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "base_template_ref": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:sim-v12-get-projection-input",
  "title": "projection-request",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "schema_id": {
      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:projection-request"
    },
    "run_handle": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
    },
    "requested_party_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
    },
    "requested_purpose": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "civil-planning",
        "science-analysis",
        "restricted-research"
      ]
    },
    "perspective": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "authorized-knowledge",
        "research-truth",
        "prediction"
      ]
    },
    "as_of": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "tick_ns": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18})$",
          "description": "semantic bounds: 0..2^63-1; distinct from uint64 seed"
        },
        "microstep": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "phase": {
          "type": "integer",
          "enum": [
            10,
            20,
            30,
            40,
            50
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "tick_ns",
        "microstep",
        "phase"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "knowledge_cursor": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "prediction_profile_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "schema_id",
    "run_handle",
    "requested_party_id",
    "requested_purpose",
    "perspective",
    "as_of",
    "knowledge_cursor",
    "prediction_profile_ref"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    {

        },

                },

                  "title": "population-scope",
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "schema_id": {
                      "const": "urn:space-sim:design:v12:population-scope"
                    },
                    "scope_id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                    },
                    "purpose": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 256
                    },
                    "policy_ref": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                    },
                    "entitlement_revision": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                    },
                    "authorized_run_handles": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                      },
                      "minItems": 0,
                      "maxItems": 1000,
                      "uniqueItems": true
                    },
                    "planned_within_scope": {
                      "type": "integer",
                      "minimum": 0
                    },
                    "manifest_handle": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                    },
                    "completeness_semantics": {
                      "const": "within-authorized-scope"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "schema_id",
                    "scope_id",
                    "purpose",
                    "policy_ref",
                    "entitlement_revision",
                    "authorized_run_handles",
                    "planned_within_scope",
                    "manifest_handle",
                    "completeness_semantics"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "slots": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "logical_run_handle": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                      },
                      "status": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": [
                          "planned",
                          "running",
                          "completed",
                          "failed",
                          "cancelled"
                        ]
                      },
                      "attempt_handles": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                        },
                        "minItems": 0,
                        "maxItems": 100
                      },
                      "selected_terminal_attempt": {
                        "anyOf": [
                          {
                            "type": "string",
                            "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"
                          },
                          {
                            "type": "null"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "metrics": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "metric_id": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$"
                            },
                            "value": {
                              "anyOf": [
                                {
                                  "type": "number"
                                },
                                {
                                  "type": "null"
                                }
                              ]
                            },
                            "unit": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "minLength": 1,
                              "maxLength": 256
                            },
                            "quality": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "enum": [
                                "valid",
                                "undefined",
                                "not-applicable",
                                "incomplete"
                              ]
                            },
                            "reason": {
                              "anyOf": [
                                {
                                  "type": "string",
                                  "minLength": 1,
                                  "maxLength": 256
                                },
                                {
                                  "type": "null"
                                }
                              ]
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [
                            "metric_id",
                            "value",
                            "unit",
                            "quality",
                            "reason"
                          ],
                          "additionalProperties": false,
                          "allOf": [
                            {
                              "if": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "quality": {
                                    "const": "valid"
                                  }
                                }
                              },
                              "then": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "value": {
                                    "type": "number"
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            },
                            {
                              "if": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "quality": {
                                    "enum": [
                                      "undefined",
                                      "not-applicable"
                                    ]
                                  }
                                }
                              },
                              "then": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "value": {
                                    "type": "null"
                                  },
                                  "reason": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "minLength": 1,
                                    "maxLength": 256
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            },
                            {
                              "if": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "quality": {
                                    "const": "incomplete"
                                  }
                                }
                              },
                              "then": {
                                "properties": {
                                  "reason": {
                                    "type": "string",
                                    "minLength": 1,
                                    "maxLength": 256
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            }
                          ]
                        },
                        "minItems": 0,
                        "maxItems": 128
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "logical_run_handle",
                      "status",
                      "attempt_handles",
                      "selected_terminal_attempt",
                      "metrics"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false
                  },
                  "minItems": 0,

                },

                },

                },

                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "party-knowledge",
                    "approved-shared-knowledge",
                    "truth-baseline"
                  ]
                },
                "release_profile_ref": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}@(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"
                },
                "evaluation_handle": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"

                },

                    },

                    },
                    "scope_digest": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "outcome_rule_ref": {

                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,256}$"

                  },
